question: Does latched event plasticity on visual-to-descending connections produce a repeatable practical gain over measured weights and size-matched shuffled-edge learning?

training.boundary_policy: Reset game, neural row, controller and sensory history at every boundary; clear pooled eligibility and dopamine traces and pending teaching pulses whenever any fly ends. Terminal-event teaching pulses do not carry into the next episode. Stop each fly at its exact quota.

evaluation.weights: frozen final checkpoints only; no best-checkpoint or seed selection
evaluation.lr0_reuse: Only after all four lr0 checkpoints are bit-identical to measured weights, reuse the measured frozen evaluation for them. There are nine distinct evaluated conditions per panel.
evaluation.audit: Before training, repeat every scheduled reset and check distinct 450-action traces across all training and reserved evaluation starts. Verify logged training starts against the audit and matched conditions. Evaluation additionally matches neural starts and checks weights stayed frozen.

decision.primary: utility_per_900_ticks = (kills - 0.5 * life_losses) * 900 / scored_ticks; compute per checkpoint, then equally weight the four training histories
decision.requirement: Every gate must pass independently in BOTH reserved panels: pooled on-rule utility gains at least 0.25 over measured and shuffled means; kill rate at least 95% of each control; life-loss rate no higher than either control; at least three of four on-rule histories beat both their matched shuffled history and measured weights in utility.
decision.interpretation: A small, fixed-budget practical screen, not a powered statistical demonstration of general learning. Each shared four-fly weight matrix is one training history. No p-value treats its episodes as independently trained brains.
decision.if_pass: Retain the working pilot and plan a larger independent confirmation before claiming a general learning benefit.
decision.if_fail: Close this Battlezone plasticity campaign without parameter tuning or extra selected tests. Keep the working pilot; redirect the next research milestone to a focused visual task such as target tracking or motion steering.
decision.if_incomplete: Report inconclusive due to incomplete protocol; do not score partial runs as a success or a negative learning result.

budget.stop: One campaign, final checkpoints only, fixed episode caps. Stop and report incomplete on any error, source/plan mismatch, audit failure, or two-hour wall limit. Run both reserved panels even if the first fails. No automatic retry or extra training.
